editorial:
If you enjoy classic fantasy adventures with witches, monsters, and a reluctant hero, Seventh Son delivers a fun ride. The story follows Tom Ward, a young farmer's son who discovers he is the seventh son of a seventh son, making him the perfect apprentice for John Gregory, a grizzled witch hunter known as the Spook. Gregory has spent his life battling dark creatures, but time is catching up with him, and Tom is his last hope. Together they face Mother Malkin, a powerful witch who has escaped imprisonment and plans to unleash darkness across the land. The movie has a big, sweeping fantasy feel with plenty of creature fights and magical showdowns.

Jeff Bridges brings his usual charm to Gregory, even if his accent is a bit odd, and Julianne Moore clearly has a blast playing the villain. The action scenes are energetic and the special effects hold up well, though the story can feel rushed and some characters get little development. It is not a masterpiece, but it is an easy, entertaining watch for fantasy fans. If you want a light adventure, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Tom Ward confronts Mother Malkin after she has grown powerful and nearly unstoppable. Using the special blade meant to kill witches, Tom strikes her down and ends her threat. Alice, who had been torn between her witch heritage and her feelings for Tom, chooses to side with him. John Gregory survives his wounds and passes the torch to Tom, who accepts his role as the new Spook. The movie ends with Tom ready to continue protecting the land from dark creatures, setting up a possible future adventure.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fantasy adventures with monsters and magic.
